_found_after_the_runs._about: Found while labelling blind trials of batch 1 (before any verdict on them). The pre-run review above is unchanged: it remains the exclusion rule (amendment 2, C.9).
_found_after_the_runs.P-G4-LIN-01-I13: Defective probe (found by 05:32, labelled at 05:32:46): its seed removes the target p-atlas, and with it Atlas's Meridian milestone m-ms1 and Canyon's issue i-canyon1 that pointed to it. So p-canyon reaches no Meridian milestone due Dec 2, and the probe cannot expose R:ProjectMilestone.projectId. The absence twin of the same seed (AT-G4-LIN-01-I13) failed the code's witness check for this reason and was never run; autogen_01's suite derivation does not run that check on probes. The same check flags 2 of autogen_01's pairs of this kind (AP-SLK-03 and AP2-SLK-03, R:message_reactions) and 1 whose near miss becomes a match once the target is removed (AP-SLK-05, created_at).
_found_after_the_runs.G4-LIN-02: The run date matters (found by 05:33, labelled at 05:33:40). 'Overdue' is relative to today, which neither the prompt nor the replica sets; the scenario assumes 2026-09-30 (i-web-3 'due today'). With the runs on 2026-09-27, every record keeps its intended class (any date from 09-23 to 09-30 does), but after 09-30 i-web-3 becomes overdue and a second match. Qwen never ran `date` and assumed an earlier today ('a future due date (2026-09-21)'), and was right only because the near miss is also Done.
